decision.rationale: TXN-007850 (928.95 EUR, Brightwater Devices, MER-000050) is on card CRD-000034. It posted on 2026-09-13. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 47 days later, which is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000004 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-09-17. The dispute was opened 43 days after that, so the 15-day wait in goods-not-received-wait has passed. The carrier's delivery record DOC-000005 shows the parcel was delivered on 2026-09-17 to the cardholder's address in Lille and signed for by H. Laurent. That matches the cardholder profile: Hugo Laurent, Lille. Under goods-not-received-proof-of-delivery, a carrier record showing delivery to the cardholder's address, signed for in the cardholder's name, means the goods are treated as received, so the dispute is declined. No document contained instructions to the bank.

proposed_actions.reason: The carrier's record shows your order from Brightwater Devices was delivered to your address in Lille on 2026-09-17 and signed for by H. Laurent. Under our policy the goods are treated as received, so we cannot uphold the dispute.
